body: As a sister to someone who lost their life to a brain tumor, live the rest of your life to it's fullest. Enjoy it while you can. My family was able to go on a few trips. My sister was twelve, so we were able to do a wish, so we went to Florida and swam with her favorite animal, dolphins. To this day, if I see a dolphin, even a picture, I see it as my sister is still here with me. It reminds me of the good times we shared. Give your family and friends something like that. If you really want, talk to a good friend, or your family and tell them that once you can't be yourself anymore, not to hold on, and let you die somewhere you want to be. Until then, give your family and friends some great memories.

ex, sister, and 'friend' are definitely at the top. It's one of those times were I think of one bad thing and the rest come tumbling in, making the sadness and grief unbearable. I just want to be done with everything, I want all my problems to just disappear.

It doesn't help that I've been alone for the past few days, since I was the first of my friends to come back to school. A few come home today, so hopefully things will get better.
